sicherung.bitte-eine-zahl-zwischen: Please enter a number between {min} and {max}.
sicherung.die-uhrzeit-bitte-als: Please enter the time as HH:MM, e.g. 02:00.
sicherung.es-laeuft-bereits-bitte: Already running: {titel}. Please wait until it has finished.
sicherung.gerade-laeuft-eine-wiederherst: A restore or test is running right now. Please wait until it has finished.
sicherung.die-automatische-sicherung-lae: Automatic backup can only be switched on once you have downloaded the emergency sheet – because a backup can only be opened with the key on it.
sicherung.nur-neueste-ohne-ausser-haus: “Keep only the newest locally” is only possible once an off-site backup is set up and its last copy succeeded – otherwise there would be no older backup left.
sicherung.die-uhrzeit-bitte-als-2: Please enter the time as HH:MM, e.g. 04:00.
sicherung.ohne-schluessel-keine-sicherun: No backup without a key: create it first under Workbench → Encryption.
sicherung.zu-wenig-freier-speicherplatz: Not enough free space in the backup folder: {replace} GB free, at least {mindestFreiGB} GB set.
sicherung.wozu-ungueltig: Please give "What for?" as a short text of at most {max} characters.
sicherung.platz-reicht-voraussichtlich-n: There probably isn’t enough space for the next backup: {frei} GB free, the backup needs about {geschaetzt} GB, and {mindestFreiGB} GB should stay free afterwards. Ablago skipped it so the disk doesn’t fill up.
sicherung.aes-256-gcm-schluessel: AES-256-GCM, key derived via HKDF-SHA256 from the Workbench key, content gzip-compressed
sicherung.diese-sicherung-gibt-es-2: This backup doesn’t exist (any more) – it was probably removed by the retention.
sicherung.diese-sicherung-wurde-dem: This backup wasn’t reported to the package (event sicherung.fertig) – it may only read those.
sicherung.zu-dieser-sicherung-fehlen: The metadata for this backup is missing.
sicherung.entfernt.liste-ungueltig: The destination didn’t return a valid list of backups.
sicherung.entfernt.laeufer: The package runner isn’t running – off-site backups can’t be queried.
sicherung.entfernt.schon-lokal: This backup is already stored locally.
sicherung.entfernt.grund.kann-nicht: The destination’s package can’t fetch backups back. Get the file and its .json from the destination yourself (see the guide).
sicherung.entfernt.grund.nicht-erreichba: The destination can’t be reached right now.
sicherung.entfernt.grund.nicht-am-ziel: The destination no longer lists this backup.
sicherung.entfernt.grund.ohne-pruefsumme: The metadata (.json) with the checksum is missing at the destination – Ablago can’t check the copy.
sicherung.entfernt.grund.abweichend: Size or checksum at the destination differ from what Ablago recorded when backing up.
sicherung.entfernt.platz: There isn’t enough space in the backup folder for this backup.
sicherung.entfernt.ausblenden-ungueltig: Please choose one or more backups that only exist off-site.
sicherung.entfernt.ausblenden-lokal: This backup also exists locally. Removing from the list only works for backups that only exist off-site.
sicherung.entfernt.stillstand: The package didn’t deliver the whole backup.
sicherung.entfernt.vorbereiten: Ablago couldn’t create the temporary files in the backup folder ({grund}). Check free space and write permissions, then try again.
sicherung.entfernt.pruefsumme: The checksum of the fetched file differs – Ablago discarded it.
sicherung.entfernt.nicht-angefordert: Ablago didn’t request this backup from this package.
sicherung.entfernt.versatz: Expected the piece starting at byte {versatz}.
sicherung.entfernt.zu-gross: The piece goes beyond the size of the backup ({groesse} bytes).
sicherung.geprueft-braucht-pruefung-prue: “geprueft” needs pruefung: pruefsumme or stichprobe. Only the size confirmed means “hochgeladen” with pruefung: groesse.
sicherung.mit-pruefsumme-oder-stichprobe: Checked with checksum or sample means status: geprueft.
sicherung.das-paket-meldet-einen: The package reports an error without text.
sicherung.ablago-die-letzte-sicherung: Ablago: the last backup is too old
sicherung.die-letzte-erfolgreiche-sicher: The last successful backup is from {wert} – older than {ZU_ALT_TAGE} days.
sicherung.es-gibt-noch-keine: There is no successful backup yet, although automatic backup is switched on.
sicherung.ablago-die-letzte-kopie: Ablago: the last off-site copy is too old
sicherung.die-letzte-kopie-ausser: The last off-site copy is of the backup of {wann}
sicherung.es-gibt-noch-keine-2: There is no off-site copy yet
sicherung.details-stehen-in-der: {text}Details are in the Workbench under “Backup” and in the log (module sicherung).
vollexport.liesmich-windows:
## Windows reports “invalid”

Windows Explorer rejects a whole ZIP (“The compressed (zipped) folder is invalid”) as soon as a path in it is 260 bytes or longer (umlauts and other non-ASCII characters count double). Ablago therefore keeps paths below 200 bytes; older exports can be longer. Your data is still complete:

- Check the ZIP against its SHA-256 as described above.
- Extract it with another program, for example 7-Zip.
- Choose a short target folder when extracting, for example `C:\Export`: long paths also cause trouble in Windows after extracting (copying, deleting, backing up).

wiederherstellung.es-laeuft-bereits-eine: A backup, check or restore is already running.
wiederherstellung.das-geht-nur-im: That only works in administration mode with the permission for “Backup”.
wiederherstellung.wiederherstellen-geht-: Restoring only works in active maintenance mode – switch it on under Workbench → Maintenance and sign everyone out.
wiederherstellung.diese-sicherung-gibt-e: This backup doesn’t exist in the backup folder (any more). “Check again” rereads the folder.
wiederherstellung.zu-dieser-sicherung-fe: The metadata file (.json) for this backup is missing. Put it into the backup folder too – for an off-site copy, the .json from the destination.
wiederherstellung.neben-dieser-sicherung: Next to this backup there is only the slim metadata file (off-site copy). Ablago reads version and scope from the backup itself with the key.
wiederherstellung.gib-den-schluessel-vom: Enter the key from the emergency sheet (fingerprint {fingerabdruck}) – then Ablago checks the backup.
wiederherstellung.die-metadaten-datei-js: The metadata file (.json) of this backup is invalid or altered.
wiederherstellung.die-sicherung-stammt-v: The backup comes from a newer Ablago version ({dms}, database state {datenbankStand}). This installation ({dms2}) doesn’t know one database change. Update Ablago first.
The backup comes from a newer Ablago version ({dms}, database state {datenbankStand}). This installation ({dms2}) doesn’t know {anzahl} database changes. Update Ablago first.
wiederherstellung.steht-nicht-in-der: isn’t in the slim metadata file; the database state is what counts
wiederherstellung.aelter-wird-nach-dem: older – brought up to date after restoring
wiederherstellung.andere-hauptversion-ge: different major version – works, the data is read in anew
wiederherstellung.die-sicherung-gehoert-: The backup belongs to the library {haushaltId}; this installation has so far been set to {haushaltId2}. Ablago takes over the backup’s ID when restoring.
The backup belongs to the library {haushaltId}; this installation is set to {haushaltId2} – otherwise the data can’t be seen.
wiederherstellung.der-eingegebene-schlue: The key entered doesn’t have the right form: 43 characters from A–Z, a–z, 0–9, - and _ (spaces don’t count).
The key entered has the fingerprint {fingerabdruck}; the backup needs {fingerabdruck2}. Use the emergency sheet for this backup.
wiederherstellung.der-schluessel-dieser-: This installation’s key doesn’t match the backup (fingerprint {fingerabdruck}). Enter the key from the emergency sheet.
wiederherstellung.sicherungsdatei-und-me: Backup file and metadata don’t match (different keys).
wiederherstellung.die-sicherung-laesst-s: The backup can’t be read with this key: {message}
wiederherstellung.bitte-den-schluessel-v: Please enter the key from the emergency sheet.
wiederherstellung.der-schluessel-passt-n: The key doesn’t match the backup (expected {fingerabdruck}).
wiederherstellung.bitte-bestaetigen-dass: Please confirm that the current state will be replaced.
wiederherstellung.vorher-abgewaehlt: deselected – without a backup of the current state
wiederherstellung.vorher-gescheitert: The backup of the current state could not be started: {grund}
wiederherstellung.es-gibt-noch-keine: There is no backup to check yet.
wiederherstellung.die-sicherung-braucht-: The backup needs the key {fingerabdruck}; this installation has {wert}.
wiederherstellung.zu-wenig-platz-fuer: Not enough space for the backup’s files: {replace} GB free, about {replace2} GB needed.
wiederherstellung.nicht-moeglich-diese-i: not possible: this installation has no matching key. The previous state stays in the database for {BEHALTEN_TAGE} days.
wiederherstellung.die-sicherung-enthaelt: The backup doesn’t contain a check word yet (older than 0.20).
wiederherstellung.pg-trgm-und-unaccent: pg_trgm and unaccent available, trigram indexes created
wiederherstellung.ersetzt-die-bisherige-: replaced; the previous one is next to it ({pop})
wiederherstellung.der-bisherige-stand-li: The previous state stays in the database for another {BEHALTEN_TAGE} days as the schema {altSchema} (there was no backup before).
